quiz.title: Expressions courantes : salutations, formules de politesse, phrases simples
quiz.subject: Anglais

answers.correction: 'Hello' is a common English greeting used to say hi or welcome someone.
'Thank you' is indeed a phrase used to express gratitude in English.
'See you later' is a common English expression used to say goodbye or indicate that you will see someone again in the future.
'Please' is indeed a word used to make requests more polite in English.
'How are you?', 'What's up?', and 'How's it going?' are all common English expressions used to ask how someone is doing or feeling.
'Excuse me' is indeed a phrase used to get someone's attention or apologize in English.
'Thank you', 'You're welcome', and 'Great job' are all common English expressions used to show appreciation.
'Have a nice day' is indeed a common way to wish someone well in English.
